seo.title: HND Airport Guide: Tokyo Haneda Terminals & Transport | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Tokyo's downtown airport: terminals, Tokyo Monorail, Keikyu Line, and transit
seo.meta_description: Complete passenger guide for Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND). Covers Tokyo Monorail, Keikyu Line, Terminal 3 international transit, and lounges.

faqs.answer: Tokyo Monorail reaches Hamamatsucho on the Yamanote line in 13 minutes, while the Keikyu Line reaches Shinagawa in 11 minutes.
faqs.question: How quickly can I get to central Tokyo from Haneda Airport?

steps.body: International arrivals land at Terminal 3 (or Terminal 2 International Concourse). Pre-fill immigration and customs forms on Visit Japan Web to clear electronic gates swiftly.
steps.title: 1. Immigration & Visit Japan Web QR Code

steps.body: Collect luggage on the 2nd Floor. Train ticket gates for Tokyo Monorail and Keikyu Line are situated immediately past the customs exit.
steps.title: 2. Baggage & Rail Access

arrival.summary: Visit Japan Web clearance, customs, and train stations at Terminal 3.

lounges.name: TIAT Lounge
lounges.access_summary: Priority Pass, LoungeKey, and select credit cards

notices.body: Bright green and white free shuttle buses run continuously between Terminals 1, 2, and 3 outside the arrival curb every 4 minutes.
notices.title: Free Terminal Shuttle Buses

steps.body: Terminal 1 handles domestic JAL and Skymark. Terminal 2 handles domestic ANA and select ANA international departures. Terminal 3 handles all foreign carriers and major international flights.
steps.title: 1. Terminal Assignment

departure.summary: Terminal verification and departure security procedures.

transport.name: Tokyo Monorail (Haneda Express)
transport.summary: Scenic elevated monorail whisking travelers directly to the Yamanote Line loop in 13 minutes.
transport.best_for_label: Fast connection to Tokyo Station, Ueno, and Akihabara

transport.name: Keikyu Airport Line
transport.summary: Rapid electric train connecting Haneda directly to Shinagawa (Shinkansen bullet train hub) and through to Ginza and Asakusa.
transport.best_for_label: Best for Shibuya, Shinjuku, and Shinkansen transfers
transport.pickup_location_summary: Keikyu stations at Terminals 1/2 and Terminal 3

facilities.name: Edo Ko-ji Shopping Street & Observation Deck
facilities.summary: Traditional Edo-period replica streetscape on Terminal 3 4th Floor with authentic ramen, sushi, and rooftop flight viewing.

orientation.intro: Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND) is situated just 15 km south of downtown Tokyo in Ota City.
orientation.summary: Consistently recognized as one of the cleanest and most punctual airports in the world, featuring three terminals connected by regular free shuttle buses.
